section_flow.notes: Floating nav with mix-blend-difference so logo + links invert against any background. 8x8 vermilion square logo mark + 'Onyx' wordmark in Unbounded Black tracking-tighter. Mobile clip-path circle reveal menu.

Full-screen luxury mansion image with cinematic-img filter (contrast 1.1 + brightness 0.9) + 60% black overlay. Vermilion eyebrow with letter-spacing 0.3em above an enormous 'FIND YOUR EMPIRE' Unbounded Black headline rendered with mix-blend-overlay. Two CTAs: vermilion filled btn-cinematic + outlined btn-outline.
1px vertical line with a vermilion bar that drops as you scroll — driven by ScrollTrigger scrub.
Left: 'PRECISION TERRITORY.' Unbounded headline with vermilion underline + paragraph. Right: 2x2 grid of stat cards on dark surface with thin border. $2.4B / 140+ / 98% / 24h.

'FEATURED COLLECTION' headline (second line vermilion) with 'View All Inventory' outline CTA top-right. Three property cards with aspect-4/5 images + cinematic-img filter, bottom gradient mask, 'Exclusive' or 'New' badge, then below: 'BEDS // BATHS' (vermilion // dividers) and bold Unbounded price.
Sticky full-height split: left half is agent portrait with bg-fade gradient; right half is dark pinned content panel with eyebrow + 'ALEX STONE' headline + long paragraph + Years/Awards stat pair.

Confidential inquiries pill border, gigantic 'SECURE YOUR ACQUISITION' headline, then 2-col form: name / email / phone / target market inputs + full-width textarea + full-width 'INITIATE INQUIRY' filled vermilion CTA. All placeholders uppercase tracking-widest.
Logo mark + brand on the left, terms/privacy/accessibility links center, © line right — all on the dark surface band.

hero_signature: Full-screen luxury mansion image rendered with contrast 1.1 + brightness 0.9 filter and a 60% black overlay. A vermilion (#FF3A1F) eyebrow with extreme letter-spacing 0.3em sits above the colossal 'FIND YOUR EMPIRE' headline — two lines of Unbounded Black at text-9xl with tracking-tighter and mix-blend-overlay. Below: vermilion filled btn-cinematic CTA next to a hollow outline CTA. A 'SCROLL' indicator with a 1px vertical hairline + vermilion bar marks bottom-center.
notable_features: Cinematic 2px micro-rounding ('.cinematic-radius') instead of typical 8-16px rounding — sharp slab aesthetic
mix-blend-difference on the nav so logo+links invert through any background imagery
mix-blend-overlay on the H1 so the title interacts with the photo behind it
cinematic-img filter (contrast 1.1 + brightness 0.9) applied to all photography for a graded-film look
Vermilion (#FF3A1F) as the only saturated accent — used very sparingly
Lenis smooth scroll integration (1.4s duration custom easing)
Pinned sticky agent section that holds the viewport then releases
Clip-path circle menu reveal animation (mobile overlay)
btn-cinematic with ::after gradient overlay + translateY(-2px) hover
Property card markup style: '5 BEDS // 6 BATHS' with vermilion // as divider, then Unbounded price
motion_vocabulary: GSAP hero entrance timeline (eyebrow -> title -> CTAs staggered with -0.5/-0.6 overlap)
ScrollTrigger scrub for the vertical scroll-indicator vermilion bar
Listing card stagger reveal (0.15s between cards)
Sticky agent pin via position:sticky top:0 h:100vh
Clip-path circle expand for mobile menu (0% -> 150% at top-right anchor)
Cinematic-img hover: contrast 1.2 + brightness 1 + scale 1.05 over 700ms
tailwind_extras_inline_css: Tight token system with 6 colors only. .cinematic-radius (border-radius 2px - the signature sharp edge). .reveal-mask helper (clip-path inset 0 0 100% 0). .btn-cinematic + ::after gradient overlay + hover translateY. .btn-outline (1px border, fills white on hover and inverts text). .menu-overlay clip-path circle reveal with cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) 800ms. .cinematic-img filter (contrast + brightness with hover boost). Note: mix-blend-difference nav + mix-blend-overlay h1 is the load-bearing trick.
